verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִדְבַּר־ יָ֑ם כְּסוּפ֤וֹת בַּנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לַֽחֲלֹ֔ף מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר בָּ֔א מֵאֶ֖רֶץ נוֹרָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā miḏ·bar- yām kə·sū·p̄ō·wṯ ban·ne·ḡeḇ la·ḥă·lōp̄ mim·miḏ·bār bā mê·’e·reṣ nō·w·rā·’āh
verses.literal: This is the burden against the Desert by the Sea Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev an invader comes from the desert from a land of terror
verses.literalPt: A sentença acerca do deserto do mar. Como os tufões do Sul passam com grande velocidade, assim vem ele do deserto, de uma terra horrível.

verses.original: חָז֥וּת קָשָׁ֖ה הֻגַּד־ לִ֑י הַבּוֹגֵ֤ד׀ בּוֹגֵד֙ וְהַשּׁוֹדֵ֣ד׀ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד עֲלִ֤י עֵילָם֙ צוּרִ֣י מָדַ֔י כָּל־ אַנְחָתָ֖ה הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zūṯ qā·šāh hug·gaḏ- lî hab·bō·w·ḡêḏ bō·w·ḡêḏ wə·haš·šō·w·ḏêḏ šō·w·ḏêḏ ‘ă·lî ‘ê·lām ṣū·rî mā·ḏay kāl- ’an·ḥā·ṯāh hiš·bat·tî
verses.literal: A dire vision is declared to me The traitor still betrays and the destroyer still destroys Go up O Elam Lay siege O Media I will put an end to all her groaning
verses.literalPt: Anunciada me foi uma dura visão: o pérfido procede perfidamente, e o devastador devasta. Sobe, Elão; sitia, Média; já fiz cessar todos os gemidos.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן מָלְא֤וּ מָתְנַי֙ חַלְחָלָ֔ה צִירִ֣ים אֲחָז֔וּנִי כְּצִירֵ֖י יֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי מִשְּׁמֹ֔עַ נִבְהַ֖לְתִּי מֵרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên mā·lə·’ū mā·ṯə·nay ḥal·ḥā·lāh ṣî·rîm ’ă·ḥā·zū·nî kə·ṣî·rê yō·w·lê·ḏāh na·‘ă·wê·ṯî miš·šə·mō·a‘ niḇ·hal·tî mê·rə·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . my body is filled with anguish Pain grips me like the pains of a woman in labor I am bewildered to hear I am dismayed to see
verses.literalPt: Portanto, se encheram de angústia os meus lombos; dores apoderaram-se de mim como as dores de mulher na hora do parto; torço-me com dores, de modo que não posso ouvir; espavorido sou, de modo que não posso ver.

verses.original: תָּעָ֣ה לְבָבִ֔י פַּלָּצ֖וּת בִּֽעֲתָ֑תְנִי אֵ֚ת נֶ֣שֶׁף חִשְׁקִ֔י שָׂ֥ם לִ֖י לַחֲרָדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tā·‘āh lə·ḇā·ḇî pal·lā·ṣūṯ bi·‘ă·ṯā·ṯə·nî ’êṯ ne·šep̄ ḥiš·qî śām lî la·ḥă·rā·ḏāh
verses.literal: My heart falters fear makes me tremble The twilight I desired has turned to horror
verses.literalPt: O meu coração bate violentamente, o terror me tem amedrontado; o crepúsculo que eu desejava tem-se-me tornado em tremores.

verses.original: עָרֹ֧ךְ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן צָפֹ֥ה הַצָּפִ֖ית אָכ֣וֹל שָׁתֹ֑ה ק֥וּמוּ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים מִשְׁח֥וּ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rōḵ haš·šul·ḥān ṣā·p̄ōh haṣ·ṣā·p̄îṯ ’ā·ḵō·wl šā·ṯōh qū·mū haś·śā·rîm miš·ḥū mā·ḡên
verses.literal: They prepare a table they lay out a carpet they eat they drink Rise up O princes oil the shields
verses.literalPt: Preparam a mesa, põem a sentinela, comem e bebem. Levantai-vos, príncipes, ungi o escudo.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֵלַ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑י לֵ֚ךְ הַעֲמֵ֣ד הַֽמְצַפֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִרְאֶ֖ה יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ê·lay ’ă·ḏō·nāy lêḵ ha·‘ă·mêḏ ham·ṣap·peh ’ă·šer yir·’eh yag·gîḏ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord says to me Go post a lookout and have him report what he sees
verses.literalPt: Pois assim me disse Jeová: Vai, põe a sentinela; diga ela o que vir;

verses.original: וְרָ֣אָה רֶ֗כֶב צֶ֚מֶד פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים רֶ֥כֶב חֲמ֖וֹר רֶ֣כֶב גָּמָ֑ל וְהִקְשִׁ֥יב קֶ֖שֶׁב רַב־ קָֽשֶׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh re·ḵeḇ ṣe·meḏ pā·rā·šîm re·ḵeḇ ḥă·mō·wr re·ḵeḇ gā·māl wə·hiq·šîḇ qe·šeḇ raḇ- qā·šeḇ
verses.literal: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen riders on donkeys riders on camels he must be alert . . . fully alert
verses.literalPt: quando vir uma tropa de cavaleiros de dois a dois, uma tropa de jumentos e uma tropa de camelos, escutará diligentemente com grande atenção.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אַרְיֵ֑ה עַל־ מִצְפֶּ֣ה׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י אָנֹכִ֞י עֹמֵ֤ד תָּמִיד֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַל־ מִ֨שְׁמַרְתִּ֔י אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב כָּל־ הַלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ar·yêh ‘al- miṣ·peh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·mêḏ tā·mîḏ yō·w·mām wə·‘al- miš·mar·tî ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ kāl- hal·lê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then the lookout shouted Day after day my lord I stand on the watchtower night after night I stay at my post
verses.literalPt: Então, clamou como um leão: Sobre a atalaia, Senhor, eu me acho em pé continuamente de dia e fico no meu posto todas as noites.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־ זֶ֥ה בָא֙ רֶ֣כֶב אִ֔ישׁ צֶ֖מֶד פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָפְלָ֤ה נָֽפְלָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְכָל־ פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ שִׁבַּ֥ר לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- zeh ḇā re·ḵeḇ ’îš ṣe·meḏ pā·rā·šîm way·ya·‘an way·yō·mer nā·p̄ə·lāh nā·p̄ə·lāh bā·ḇel wə·ḵāl pə·sî·lê ’ĕ·lō·he·hā šib·bar lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Look here come the riders . . . horsemen in pairs And one answered saying Fallen fallen is Babylon All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground
verses.literalPt: Eis aqui vem uma tropa de homens, cavaleiros de dois a dois. Ele respondeu e disse: Caiu, caiu Babilônia; e todas as imagens esculpidas dos seus deuses são despedaçadas até o chão.

verses.original: מְדֻשָׁתִ֖י וּבֶן־ גָּרְנִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִגַּ֥דְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: mə·ḏu·šā·ṯî ū·ḇen- gā·rə·nî ’ă·šer šā·ma‘·tî mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hig·gaḏ·tî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: O my people crushed on the threshing floor I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Debulha minha e filho da minha eira, o que tenho ouvido da parte de Jeová dos Exércitos, isso vos tenho anunciado.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דּוּמָ֑ה אֵלַי֙ קֹרֵ֣א מִשֵּׂעִ֔יר שֹׁמֵר֙ מַה־ מִלַּ֔יְלָה שֹׁמֵ֖ר מַה־ מִלֵּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā dū·māh ’ê·lay qō·rê miś·śê·‘îr šō·mêr mah- mil·lay·lāh šō·mêr mah- mil·lêl
verses.literal: This is the burden against Dumah One calls to me from Seir Watchman what is left of the night Watchman what is left of the night
verses.literalPt: A sentença acerca de Dumá. Clamam-me de Seir: Guarda, quanto resta da noite?

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר שֹׁמֵ֔ר אָתָ֥ה בֹ֖קֶר וְגַם־ לָ֑יְלָה אִם־ תִּבְעָי֥וּן בְּעָ֖יוּ שֻׁ֥בוּ אֵתָֽיוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar šō·mêr ’ā·ṯāh ḇō·qer wə·ḡam- lā·yə·lāh ’im- tiḇ·‘ā·yūn bə·‘ā·yū šu·ḇū ’ê·ṯā·yū
verses.literal: The watchman replies Morning has come but also the night If you would inquire then inquire Come back yet again
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o guarda: Vem a manhã, também a noite; se quereis perguntar, perguntai; tornai-vos, vinde.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּעְרָ֑ב בַּיַּ֤עַר בַּעְרַב֙ תָּלִ֔ינוּ אֹֽרְח֖וֹת דְּדָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ba‘·rāḇ bay·ya·‘ar ba‘·raḇ tā·lî·nū ’ō·rə·ḥō·wṯ də·ḏā·nîm
verses.literal: This is the burden against Arabia In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge O caravans of Dedanites
verses.literalPt: A sentença acerca da Arábia. Nos bosques da Arábia, passareis a noite, ó caravanas de dedanitas.

verses.original: לִקְרַ֥את צָמֵ֖א הֵתָ֣יוּ מָ֑יִם יֹשְׁבֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ תֵּימָ֔א בְּלַחְמ֖וֹ קִדְּמ֥וּ נֹדֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: liq·raṯ ṣā·mê hê·ṯā·yū mā·yim yō·šə·ḇê ’e·reṣ tê·mā bə·laḥ·mōw qid·də·mū nō·ḏêḏ
verses.literal: Bring water for the thirsty O dwellers of Tema meet the refugees with food
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram água aos sequiosos; os habitantes da terra de Tema foram com o seu pão ao encontro dos fugitivos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת נָדָ֑דוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י׀ חֶ֣רֶב נְטוּשָׁ֗ה וּמִפְּנֵי֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת דְּרוּכָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י כֹּ֥בֶד מִלְחָמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- mip·pə·nê ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ nā·ḏā·ḏū mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ nə·ṭū·šāh ū·mip·pə·nê qe·šeṯ də·rū·ḵāh ū·mip·pə·nê kō·ḇeḏ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: For they flee from the sword . . . the sword that is drawn from the bow that is bent and from the stress of battle
verses.literalPt: Pois eles fugiram de diante das espadas, de diante da espada desembainhada, de diante do arco armado e de diante da pressão da guerra.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֛ה אָמַ֥ר אֲדֹנָ֖י אֵלָ֑י בְּע֤וֹד שָׁנָה֙ כִּשְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְכָלָ֖ה כָּל־ כְּב֥וֹד קֵדָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ê·lāy bə·‘ō·wḏ šā·nāh kiš·nê śā·ḵîr wə·ḵā·lāh kāl- kə·ḇō·wḏ qê·ḏār
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord says to me . . . Within one year as a hired worker would count it all the glory of Kedar will be gone
verses.literalPt: Porque assim me disse Jeová: Ainda dentro de um ano, como os anos de um jornaleiro, e toda a glória de Quedar se esvaecerá.

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֧ר מִסְפַּר־ קֶ֛שֶׁת גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ קֵדָ֖ר יִמְעָ֑טוּ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār mis·par- qe·šeṯ gib·bō·w·rê ḇə·nê- qê·ḏār yim·‘ā·ṭū kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl dib·bêr
verses.literal: The remaining . . . archers the warriors of Kedar will be few For the LORD the God of Israel has spoken
verses.literalPt: Aquilo que restar do número dos flecheiros, homens valentes dos filhos de Quedar, será diminuto, porque Jeová, Deus de Israel, o disse.
